result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: overlapping metadata text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card. The remaining layout (header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels, bottom nav) renders correctly.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the delivery time '25–35 min' and the delivery fee '€0 delivery' are rendered on top of each other, producing garbled, unreadable text ('25–3€0 mdelivery') before the '• Ramen' label.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata items in a horizontal flex row with proper spacing/separators (e.g., '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') instead of absolutely positioning them at the same origin, and ensure each item gets its own width.
